### Another Request for a Sign
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/another-request-sign
Passage: Matthew 16:1-4
Points:
- The Pharisees and Sadducees put aside their theological divisions solely to oppose Jesus and test His authority.
- Although capable of forecasting the weather from the sky, they willfully ignored the evident signs of the Messiah before them.
- Because their skepticism stemmed from spiritual blindness and hard-heartedness, Jesus refused to grant them another heavenly sign.
- The only sign granted would be the sign of Jonah, pointing forward to Christ's death and miraculous resurrection.
- Believers must guard against demanding extra signs or answers from God while neglecting the clear revelation He has already given.
